components.text: QPair lets you see call, message and social network notifications from your phone on your tablet
Use QPair to ring your phone or tablet to help you find it. The phone or tablet will ring even when set for no sound.
Some features may be limited depending on your carrier's policy or your phone model
Phone and tablet will be paired.
Tap Start on the tablet as well.
Getting started may take up to one minute.
Once a tablet is found, it will be connected automatically. When two or more tablets are found, select the tablet name below.
